title: Bug Too! Motto Motto Jump Shite, Funzukechatte, Petchanko
native_title: バグ・トゥー！ ～もっともっと・ジャンプ・して、ふんづけちゃって、ぺっちゃんこ～
overview:
Jump even more, stomp on them, and squash them flat.

This time "Bug" has two friends (or two critters?)!! The cute pet "Maggot Dog" and the 70s-loving dude "Superfly" join "Bug" for big action~!!

Bug and his co-stars have signed a deal to shoot six movies in a single day. Pick your star and hop along winding 3D tracks floating in the air, stomping enemies, flipping switches and finding the way through maze-like paths to the Bug Stop at the end of each scene.

Each of the six movie-parody worlds lets you choose its scenes in any order from a hub, with a boss waiting once all are cleared. Grab power-ups for a spitting attack and keep an eye on your Bug Juice health meter.

- Three playable characters: Bug, Maggot Dog and Superfly
- Two-player mode with alternating turns and high-score competition
- Progress saved to memory backup

もっともっとジャンプして、ふんづけちゃって、ぺっちゃんこ

今度の"BUG"には仲間が2人(匹?)!!かわいいペットの"MAGGOT・DOG"と70年代大好き野郎の"SUPERFLY"が、"BUG"と一緒に大活躍だ～!!
